journey.name: MOD-02: 对话主工作台与时间线交互
journey.description: 验证主工作台对话时间线界面加载正常，能够正确展示历史消息或初始就绪提示，支持消息气泡滚动与触控交互，且主工作台各功能入口布局对齐规范。

actions.action: Verify that the workbench top bar is visible
Verify that the message timeline container is visible
Verify that the message input bar "输入消息或 / 命令..." is visible at the bottom
Swipe down on the message timeline to view earlier messages
Swipe up on the message timeline to return to latest messages
Verify that the "添加附件" button is visible and enabled
Verify that the "发送" button is visible
